features.name: 18CricketNetwork
features.offer: One place to discover cricket people, venues, scoring, gear, food and services.
features.policy: Use real profiles and listings. An interface or enquiry is not a promise of stock, booking availability or provider activation.
features.limits: Sites remains a private pilot. The standalone preview shows the welcome page only until authentication and storage are activated. Native mobile distribution is not yet activated.

features.name: Player passports
features.offer: Create a player identity with roles, batting and bowling preferences, and recorded performance.
features.policy: Only edit profiles you own. Profile claims are not independently verified credentials.
features.limits: A profile does not guarantee selection, recruitment or a verified ranking.

features.name: Teams & clubs
features.offer: Create teams and join or leave lineups within the network.
features.policy: Only owners manage their team records; joining a listing is not final selection or a contract.
features.limits: Roster membership is distinct from the squad snapshot used for match scoring.

features.name: Match centre & scoring
features.offer: Player-attributed scoring in a futuristic Match Theatre, with boundary/wicket effects, duck annotations and ledger-derived milestones alongside the existing scorecards and controls.
features.policy: Enter actual umpire decisions. Competition score changes still require authorised approval. Animations do not change scores; previews are labelled and are not match data.
features.limits: Initial loads, corrections and missed-event catch-up do not replay effects. Hat-tricks are conservative same-innings, legal, bowler-credited sequences. No Test cricket, super overs or automated DLS; field graphics are decorative, not tracking.

features.name: Tournaments & leagues
features.offer: Competition listings, registrations, linked fixtures and points derived from recorded results.
features.policy: Creators and appointed competition admins control match approval; league authority can extend to linked tournaments.
features.limits: No universal external tournament import or automated disciplinary adjudication.

features.name: Competition permissions & safety
features.offer: Admin appointments, score-change approval and content safety operations.
features.policy: Only the competition creator appoints/removes admins. Routine text posts are not held in a general review queue; restricted patterns are rejected.
features.limits: Pattern checks are not perfect detection. Image screening needs a provider; video uploads remain blocked until screening is connected.

features.name: Player & team rankings
features.offer: Ranking logic uses eligible, reviewed match data with role and geographic/competition filters.
features.policy: No fabricated rankings. Changed, duplicate, live or unverified scorecards do not qualify automatically.
features.limits: Rankings remain empty where qualifying evidence is absent. Captaincy and fielding cannot be inferred from missing data.

features.name: Pickup cricket
features.offer: Host a game and let members join or leave its lineup.
features.policy: A join action is an expression of participation, not a paid venue reservation.
features.limits: The platform does not guarantee attendance or venue permission.

features.name: Venue discovery & ownership claims
features.offer: A sourced directory of grounds, practice facilities and academies in the USA and India, with directions and ownership claims.
features.policy: A directory entry is not a booking offer. Assignment requires private proof and platform verification of operating rights.
features.limits: The directory is not exhaustive; location and operating details may need confirmation. Approval does not replace local permissions.

features.name: Grounds & reservations
features.offer: Discover operator listings, reserve available hourly slots and navigate to venues.
features.policy: Availability conflicts are checked. Reservation and any associated financial order must be reconciled before cancellation.
features.limits: Older ground reservations do not themselves collect payment. A directory-only venue may not offer bookable slots.

features.name: Net-session booking
features.offer: Facilities publish lanes, hourly local-currency pricing and bookable practice slots.
features.policy: One slot cannot be reserved twice. Booking snapshots retain the quoted price; the platform commission is 5%.
features.limits: Only operator-published offers are bookable. No invented opening hours or lane availability.

features.name: Academies
features.offer: Academy discovery, operator listings and enquiries, plus sourced directory entries.
features.policy: Unclaimed directory entries do not imply an academy is our partner. Operators must prove rights before assignment.
features.limits: A listing is not independent accreditation or guaranteed admission.

features.name: Cricket & mindset coaching
features.offer: Discover coaches, including mindset coaches, and request eligible paid sessions.
features.policy: Prices come from the listing. Provider acceptance and verified payment precede paid fulfilment.
features.limits: Provider qualifications and availability need verification; payment setup must be activated.

features.name: Cricket services
features.offer: List and enquire about specialist cricket services, with supported paid-request workflows.
features.policy: Owners describe scope and terms; the platform cannot guarantee service quality or professional licensing.
features.limits: Only supported provider/payment flows can process a transaction.

features.name: Equipment repair & maintenance
features.offer: Find repair providers, request work, approve quotes, track stages and attach carrier documents.
features.policy: A quote needs customer approval. Private order documents are limited to participants; reference QR codes are not carrier-paid postage.
features.limits: Carrier purchasing/drop-off integration and provider warranties are not automatic. Confirm manufacturer warranty implications.

features.name: New & used cricket gear
features.offer: Brand/category filters including One8, seller stores, comparison, wishlist, orders and declared returns.
features.policy: Sellers must declare separate new/used return windows and postage terms. Buyers accept the snapshotted policy before ordering.
features.limits: Brand logos identify filters, not partnerships. A QR/barcode identifies an item or return, not automatically a valid carrier label.

features.name: 18 Shop & camera hardware
features.offer: An official hardware catalogue/enquiry interface, owner-registered camera credentials and recording-session commands.
features.policy: Only platform operations publish official products. Device credentials are shown once, stored hashed and revocable.
features.limits: Planned products are not stock. Compatibility is unverified; the gateway handles commands/telemetry, not raw video ingest or encoding.

features.name: Decision Review Studio
features.offer: Two-view human-assisted referrals, dismissal/boundary checklists, replay references and immutable decision records.
features.policy: 18-camera broadcasts require distinct bowler-end and square-leg cameras, recording acknowledgements, heartbeats and operator-declared alignment. Inconclusive evidence retains the original.
features.limits: Not ICC-certified or automatic DRS. Approved ball tracking/edge detection are not connected; LBW prediction cannot authorise OUT. Player-review clocks/quotas are disabled.

features.name: Livestreams & LED displays
features.offer: Supported cricket embeds and a futuristic fullscreen scoreboard with recorded match-moment effects.
features.policy: Obtain rights and participant consent. Camera-managed streams must pass DRS readiness; external broadcasts remain separate. Effects never replace an umpire decision.
features.limits: Five-second polling may miss effects for multiple intervening events, while retaining current scores. No upstream-stream control, direct LED protocols or completed hardware field tests.

features.name: Cricket social feed
features.offer: Cricket posts, stories, likes, comments, bookmarks, reports and performance sharing.
features.policy: Cricket-only content; restricted profanity, sexual, hate, sensitive and political content is rejected by available checks. Shared media requires permission.
features.limits: Stories leave the feed after 24 hours, not necessarily underlying storage. Reels/video uploads await automatic video safety screening.

features.name: Media studio & sharing
features.offer: Media listings, cricket highlights and generated performance cards for download or device sharing.
features.policy: Only share media and statistics you have rights to publish. Uploads must pass supported safety checks.
features.limits: Device share sheets vary. External social posting is user-controlled, not automatic cross-platform publishing.

features.name: Performance & match reports
features.offer: Ledger-derived batting/bowling figures, wickets, moments, manual field maps, notes and replay links.
features.policy: Private notes retain access restrictions. Report evidence is labelled with its origin and source scorecard version.
features.limits: Manual field maps are not automated player tracking. No fabricated ball trajectories or video-derived statistics.

features.name: Global live scores
features.offer: Read-only external cricket scores, competition discovery and follows from configured licensed feeds.
features.policy: Display/redistribution permission is required. External scores never modify local scoring, rankings or tournament results.
features.limits: Coverage depends on the provider, not a promise of every IPL, domestic or international match.

features.name: Athlete Fuel & team meals
features.offer: Restaurant menus, individual/team orders, pickup and supported PitchRush delivery to practices, grounds or homes.
features.policy: Restaurants pay a 5% order commission. Delivery tips go 100% to the assigned driver. Menus/prices are snapshotted for orders.
features.limits: Restaurants need operational approval and payment/delivery activation. Nutritional claims are seller-provided, not medical advice.

features.name: PitchRush drivers & riders
features.offer: Driver enrolment, eligible funded jobs, road-distance quotes, pickup and photo or handover-code delivery proof.
features.policy: Operators approve drivers. Only the assigned rider completes a job; road quotes set the offer and tips belong to the rider.
features.limits: Maps and payouts need configured providers. Earnings shown as held are not bank-paid earnings. Food eligibility must be enabled for food jobs.

features.name: Maps & ground navigation
features.offer: Ground directions without a booking, location-aware route guidance and eligible delivery navigation.
features.policy: Location permission is optional. Private delivery addresses are restricted to authorised participants.
features.limits: Provider-backed routing must be configured. This is not a full Google/Apple Maps replacement or safety guarantee.

features.name: 18Basic, 18Gold & seller leads
features.offer: Free Basic access, role-priced Gold plans, consented enquiries and eligible business analytics.
features.policy: Visitor counts do not disclose anonymous visitors’ identities. Leads require explicit contact consent; detailed analytics/leads need active role-specific Gold.
features.limits: Membership billing is not activated. Operator pilot grants and verified unexpired entitlements control access; non-seller prices are proposed.

features.name: 18Digital assistant
features.offer: Premium text answers with browser voice input and spoken replies where supported.
features.policy: Active Gold and a connected model provider are required. Server token/request budgets apply; clearing chat does not reset usage.
features.limits: Voice processing depends on the browser/provider, not an always-listening Siri replacement. AI answers can be wrong; no unlimited-token promise.

features.name: Scouting & opportunities
features.offer: Recruitment listings, applications and enquiries connecting cricket talent with opportunities.
features.policy: Owners manage listings; an application is not selection, employment or a verified scout endorsement.
features.limits: No guarantee of placement or independent employer background checks.

features.name: In-network messages
features.offer: Message listing owners and view participant-restricted inbox conversations.
features.policy: Messages are restricted to sender and recipient in the application; no claim of end-to-end encryption.
features.limits: Email delivery, push notifications and external messaging services are not connected.

features.name: My workspace
features.offer: A personal view of owned records, activity and supported account data export.
features.policy: Server permissions still govern every edit. Browser cart preferences are separate from database records.
features.limits: An export is not a complete server backup; feature-specific private records may require their own interface.

features.name: Registration & sign-in
features.offer: Welcome-first access, role-based onboarding, explicit policy acknowledgements and hosted ChatGPT sign-in.
features.policy: Verified identity email comes from the authentication boundary. Client-selected roles never grant admin authority.
features.limits: Direct Google, Apple and WhatsApp authentication remain setup-pending. Native app authentication needs a separate compatible integration.

features.name: Payments, returns & settlement
features.offer: Server-priced orders, Stripe/US and Razorpay/India payment adapters, verified capture and controlled refunds/payouts.
features.policy: No paid status without provider verification. Seller return terms are frozen on the order; new/used windows and postage are declared separately.
features.limits: Provider keys, account approval and sandbox/end-to-end tests are required. Pilot defaults: new gear 8%, used gear 5%, grounds 5%, coaching/services 12%; actual order quotes prevail.

features.name: 18’s Third Umpire
features.offer: Private app reviews, bug reports and improvement suggestions, with a personal submission history.
features.policy: Visible to the submitter and platform operations. Follow-up email consent is optional; up to five submissions per 24 hours.
features.limits: Feedback email forwarding is not configured. A suggestion does not guarantee delivery of a feature.

features.name: Privacy & platform policies
features.offer: Feature-specific access controls for messages, leads, orders, ownership proof and operator notes.
features.policy: Public listings are distinct from private evidence and contact data. Platform access controls are not a promise of encryption or complete regulatory compliance.
features.limits: Formal operator identity/contact, retention/deletion schedules, disputes and jurisdiction-specific terms need finalisation before public launch. These operating notes are not final legal terms.
